answer_1.quote: The purpose of the Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) task is to correct grammatical errors in natural texts. This includes correcting errors in spelling, punctuation, grammar, morphology, word choice, and others.
answer_1.outputs: corrected versions of errorful input sentences using sequence tagging with operations such as $KEEP, $DELETE, $APPEND_t, $REPLACE_t

answer_2.quote: We report F 0.5 , P recision, and Recall metrics computed by ERRANT scorer on dev and test datasets from the W&I + LOCNESS Corpus from the BEA-2019 GEC Shared Task.
